title: Word Pattern
statement_short: Given a pattern string and a space-separated string s, determine if s follows the exact same pattern. Following the pattern means establishing a full bijection between a letter in pattern and a non-empty word in s.
constraints: 1 <= pattern.length <= 300, 1 <= s.length <= 3000, pattern contains lowercase letters, s contains lowercase letters and single spaces
hint: Small length limits do not restrict time complexity, but verifying a bijection requires dual mapping validation.
why_not: Right: HashMap / Hash Set maintains bi-directional character-to-word mappings in O(n) time. Not Two Pointers: Pointers compare element positions but cannot store and enforce word mapping history. Not Trie: Prefix trees store string prefixes rather than letter-to-word bijections. Not Sliding Window: The problem checks whole-string bijection alignment rather than managing a contiguous subsegment window.
